# Third-party dependencies

- `D1_SDK/`: official Unitree D1 SDK material required for generated DDS types
  and vendor libraries. Its original terms continue to apply.
- `unitree-d1-control/`: project-owned D1 control and diagnostics component,
  tracked directly in this repository. It retains its own CMake boundary,
  tests, license, and documentation, but does not require separate Git setup.
